hero.description: Turn a short walk through Tad Lo into a phone-based treasure hunt: follow 13 clues through the village, waterfalls and paths, validate each discovery, and unlock a drink reward when you finish.
hero.rhythmNote: The game itself is designed for roughly 15–30 minutes. Take longer if you want to wander between clues or stop around the village.

chapters.label: THE GAME
chapters.title: A village walk with 13 clues
chapters.body: Open the Treasure Hunt in your phone browser and follow 13 clues around Tad Lo at your own pace. The route uses the village, paths, waterfalls and small local details as the game board, so the point is not speed but noticing places you might otherwise walk past. No app-store download or guide is required, and completing all 13 quests unlocks a drink reward from a participating partner, subject to availability.

note.label: KEEP IT LIGHT
note.text: Free, self-guided and deliberately simple: open it on your phone, walk the clues and let the village provide the rest.

items.label: Start
items.value: Open the Treasure Hunt in your phone browser
items.detail: No app-store download is required. The official Visit Tad Lo game page launches the self-guided route directly on your phone.

items.label: Time
items.value: About 15–30 minutes for the game itself
items.detail: The activity catalogue groups it under less than three hours, but the dedicated game page gives 15–30 minutes. Allow longer if you stop between clues or combine it with a village walk.

items.label: Cost
items.detail: Downloading and playing the 13 quests is free. Complete all 13 to receive a drink from a participating partner, with the exact option depending on availability.

items.label: Route
items.detail: The game is self-guided and available year-round. Stay on public paths, respect private property and local life, and play in daylight.

faq.question: Is the Tad Lo Treasure Hunt free?
faq.answer: Yes. Visit Tad Lo lists the full 13-quest experience as free to download and play.

faq.question: How long does the Tad Lo Treasure Hunt take?
faq.answer: The dedicated game page gives about 15–30 minutes for the game itself. Take longer if you stop around the village or explore between clues.

faq.question: Do I need to download an app?
faq.answer: No. Open the Treasure Hunt in your phone browser; no app-store download is required.

faq.question: Do I need to book the Treasure Hunt?
faq.answer: No. It is a self-guided activity available year-round. Start it from your phone and play during daylight.

faq.question: What happens after completing all 13 quests?
faq.answer: Visit Tad Lo says completing all 13 quests unlocks a drink from a participating partner. The available drink depends on what the partner has at the time.
